summary: Test-writing run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Upstream dependency verified: viamin/color_matching#110 is closed and the spec is served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json; operationIds, schemas, and response shapes were extracted from api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, test_sheet_json.ex, and OpenApiSpex name-derivation rules. Wrote permanent stubbed-response unit tests for all five app surfaces plus drift/auth cases (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/GeneratedAPIClientTests.swift + GeneratedClientTestSupport.swift) and staged the PR-description contract-delta analysis in docs/openapi-client-migration.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift: command not found), and the generated client module is intentionally absent in this tests-only phase, so the new tests cannot compile here by design; they are red-phase tests for the follow-up implementation run, whose wiring contract is documented in docs/openapi-client-migration.md.
